subject: Vendor activation prerequisites and PO path for Procurely
messages:
From: Alison Grant <alison.grant@procurely.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-05-15T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood vendor onboarding — kickoff

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the intro call earlier. We're excited to get Procurely set up as an approved vendor for Redwood so we can start the integration work next week. Can you confirm what your procurement team needs to get a PO issued and vendor activated? Specifically: 

- Required tax forms (W-9 or W-8)
- Bank detail format and preferred quick-pay options
- Any vendor registration or portal we should sign up for
- Whether a signed MSA is required before PO issuance or if you can provision a preliminary PO

We also have a handful of internal compliance questions (SOC 2 snapshot, data handling summary) if that helps accelerate the legal review.

If you send me a short checklist of "what you need from us" and "what you will provide", I'll assemble and return the documents today. We're aiming for a 5/18 kickoff if possible.

Thanks,
Alison Grant
Head of Strategic Ops, Procurely
Alison Grant <alison.grant@procurely.com>
Procurely, Inc.

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alison Grant <alison.grant@procurely.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-05-15T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood vendor onboarding — kickoff

Hi Alison — great to hear and glad to align on timing. Below is our standard activation checklist. I attached a short PDF checklist for your convenience (vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf).

What we need from you (as a starting set):
- Completed W-9 (U.S. vendors) or W-8 (non-U.S.) — PDF scan works
- Bank account details for ACH (account name, routing/IBAN, bank name) — PDF preferred
- Primary billing contact name, email, and phone
- Signed Master Services Agreement (we can send via DocuSign; if you prefer countersign, let us know)
- Invoice sample that matches your billing system (one PDF)
- Company legal name, address, and VAT/Tax ID (if applicable)

What we provide / next steps on our side:
- Finance will create a PO once W-9 + signed MSA are in place (typical lead time 3–7 business days)
- We’ll provision a procurement reference number and share it in HubSpot (see link below)
- On day of PO issuance we’ll confirm billing email and PO number to you
- If you need expedited processing for the 5/18 kickoff, flag it in your reply and we’ll route with priority (expedites are handled by finance approvals)

Notes about invoicing: Redwood requires invoices to reference the PO number exactly; payment terms are Net 30 by default but we can discuss alternate terms in the contract.

DocuSign: I will send our standard MSA via DocuSign — please expect a link in a separate email. HubSpot record for this opportunity: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/78910

Jonas
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alison Grant <alison.grant@procurely.com>
Cc: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-05-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood vendor onboarding — finance intake and PO cadence

Hi Alison — looping in Finance to clarify our PO intake. A couple quick details to make sure your submission is processed without delays: 

1) Required items before PO creation:
   - Signed MSA (DocuSign link will be provided)
   - Completed W-9 (for U.S. entities) or W-8BEN-E for non-U.S.
   - Bank details for ACH in a secure PDF (please do not email plain-text account numbers)

2) Invoice/PO matching rules:
   - Invoice must include Redwood PO number, invoice date, invoice number, line-item descriptions that match SOW
   - Attach backup (time/hours or deliverable list) when applicable

3) Timeline:
   - Once we receive the documents above, Finance aims to issue a PO within 3–7 business days. If you select "expedite" please indicate the business justification and a sponsor contact.

I've attached our finance PO intake template (finance_po_template.xlsx) — please use it to submit your invoice samples and bank details. If you prefer, we can provide a vendor portal invite (standard vendors get access to the portal where payments/invoices are tracked).

If you want the PO sooner for the 5/18 kickoff, please note that we still require the signed MSA before funds can be encumbered; we can, however, provision a preliminary PO number pending final MSA signature to help your team proceed with procurement planning.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com

Best,
Alison
